messages:
phil-eng: deploy-bot flagged embedding-sparse rollout v0.9.0 during the late change window. Canary p95 up ~22%, error 1.7%. deploy-bot recommends partial rollback (canary-only) or full revert. tagging @sam-oncall @yara-sre.

deploy-bot: ALERT -> REVERT_RECOMMENDATION. Triggers: p95>185ms (4m), err>1.5% (3m). Canary slice=12%. Suggested actions: PARTIAL_REVERT(canary) or FULL_ROLLBACK.

yara-sre: grabbing region split and traces. If it's canary-first we should do partial revert to avoid impacting stable traffic. But dedicated pools need pinning if we revert fully.

ops-bot: telemetry: us-west-2=68% of canary, p95_usw2=205ms, p95_eu=168ms, err_rate=1.7%. No infra alerts. Traces show long tail on model-serve-gpu-9.

nora-prod: We have 2 dedicated pools that could be affected if we flip the release. Prefer partial canary revert now, then assess. Also we need a short release-note line and to inform pool owners.

sam-oncall: I'll take this. Plan: 1) revert canary traffic to embedding-sparse:v0.8.6 (partial revert), 2) annotate release to suppress autopilot for 1h, 3) monitor 12m. If errors persist, escalate to full rollback + pin. Commands I will run with yara:
```
# partial revert
deployctl traffic shift --release embedding-sparse:v0.9.0 --target-version v0.8.6 --slice canary
# suppress autopilot temporarily
deployctl annotate --release embedding-sparse:v0.9.0 suppress_autopilot=true --ttl 1h
```

yara-sre: executing now. shifting canary -> done. suppress flag set -> done. starting 12m monitor.

deploy-bot: ACTION_LOG: partial-canary-revert executed by sam-oncall. Autopilot suppression annotated.

yara-sre: after 3m p95_usw2 down to 158ms, err 0.5%. Trending stable. Continuing monitor.

tess-pm: I'll draft a short external blurb and a one-line internal release-note. Posting to #customer-comms after ops confirms stability.

ops-bot: incident INC-2024-507777 created for RCA, assigned to eng-ml and eng-runtime. tags: partial-revert, canary, gpu-9

sam-oncall: 12m monitor complete. Canary stable. We're leaving suppression for 1h to avoid immediate autopilot flip. If eng-ml confirms root cause we'll decide about full rollback and pin.

nora-prod: Notifying dedicated pool owners to stand by. If we do a full rollback I'll pin pools to v0.8.6 until EOD.

yara-sre: Action items: eng-ml to run perf diff between v0.9.0 and v0.8.6 on gpu-9, eng-runtime to check kernel/hotpatches on that node. Release note draft: "Partial revert of embedding-sparse v0.9.0 in canary due to latency/error increase; investigation underway." Closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
